en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an interior gallery of a brick building with arches and decorated stone columns supporting an upper level. Ornate wrought‑iron railings border the gallery. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the location as the second‑floor gallery of Canisius College in Nijmegen. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century architectural photograph reproduced as a postcard.
